answer.camera_language: Smooth, purposeful advances connect the welcome to the working demonstration; readable screen holds provide contrast before the strongest advance returns authority to the manager.
answer.arc: A warm 2 rises through explanation at 3 and workflow evidence at 4, pauses on pending approval at 2, then peaks on human decision-making at 5 before releasing.

clips.trigger: The welcome and the manager's small nod.
clips.motivation: Move into the welcome without privileging either peer or relying on an imperceptible sideways drift.
clips.opens_on: Both managers waist-up, Company B left and Company A right, with the workstation between them.
clips.lands_on: Both managers chest-up, their faces equally readable across the workstation.
clips.composition_note: Give both managers equal visual weight and retain the workstation between them.
clips.why: Intimacy 2: a visible, smooth advance makes the welcome personal while preserving the managers' equal relationship.
clips.camera_sentence: From an eye-level waist-up two-shot, move slowly closer as the welcome begins, settling with both managers chest-up and their faces equally readable.

clips.motivation: Let the small nod register without manufacturing a larger reaction.
clips.opens_on: The visitor's face in close-up on the right, looking left.
clips.lands_on: The same close-up of the visitor maintaining the host's eyeline.
clips.composition_note: Keep looking space to the left toward the host.
clips.why: Intimacy 2: the deliberate stillness after the settled welcome gives the visitor's modest response its own space.
clips.camera_sentence: Hold an eye-level close-up of the visitor on the right with looking space to the left, keeping the same framing through the small nod.

clips.direction: straight toward Company B Operations Manager
clips.trigger: The manager begins the explanatory phrase.
clips.motivation: Give the explanation a clear visual progression toward the person with practical expertise.
clips.opens_on: Company B Operations Manager waist-up on the left third, facing right.
clips.lands_on: Company B Operations Manager chest-up, retaining rightward looking space.
clips.angle_reason: A restrained upward view gives the host professional authority as the knowledgeable guide, without making the visitor subordinate.
clips.composition_note: Retain the left-third placement and clear rightward eyeline throughout the advance.
clips.why: Dialogue 2: a measured advance emphasizes practical expertise while remaining calm enough for the speaking face.
clips.camera_sentence: From a slightly low waist-up view, move slowly toward the manager as the explanation begins, settling chest-up with looking space to the right.

clips.direction: straight toward Company B Operations Manager
clips.trigger: The explanation turns to connected business processes.
clips.motivation: Make process integration feel like the explanatory step that unlocks the coming demonstration.
clips.opens_on: Company B Operations Manager chest-up on the left third, looking right.
clips.lands_on: A close-up of the manager's face with the same rightward eyeline.
clips.composition_note: Keep the face left of centre and preserve the visitor's offscreen position to the right.
clips.why: Reveal 3: the closer landing distinguishes the integration idea from the introductory explanation without adding artificial spectacle.
clips.camera_sentence: From an eye-level chest-up view, move slowly closer as the explanation turns to integration, settling on the manager's face with looking space to the right.

clips.trigger: The conference enquiry appears in the blank request area.
clips.motivation: Let the interface supply the reveal while the camera gives the requirements uninterrupted reading time.
clips.opens_on: The computer display fills the image with the request area blank.
clips.lands_on: The same display insert containing the complete conference request.
clips.angle_reason: The lens is level with the display at workstation height so the request remains square and legible.
clips.composition_note: Keep every requirement inside the display crop with comfortable margins.
clips.why: Reveal 3: holding square to the screen lets the actual request, rather than camera motion, introduce the demonstration's concrete input.
clips.camera_sentence: Hold a straight-on insert level with the display as the enquiry appears, ending with the complete request and all its requirements inside the frame.

clips.direction: toward the manager and display together
clips.trigger: The explanation of the workflow begins, continuing into dashboard activation.
clips.motivation: Bring the guide and working interface closer as a single piece of evidence rather than separating voice from demonstration.
clips.opens_on: Company B Operations Manager waist-up at left, with the inactive workflow display at right.
clips.lands_on: The manager chest-up at left beside the complete active workflow area at right.
clips.composition_note: Advance toward the midpoint between face and display, retaining the complete workflow area rather than cropping into individual nodes.
clips.why: Reveal 3: the smooth advance visibly joins the explanation to its working evidence while the deep stop keeps both readable.
clips.camera_sentence: From an eye-level waist-up view, move slowly toward the manager and display as the explanation unfolds, settling chest-up with the full active workflow area beside the face.

clips.trigger: The four agents and their connected resources appear together.
clips.motivation: Give simultaneous activity a stable visual field so viewers can understand parallel roles rather than chase a moving frame.
clips.opens_on: Company B Operations Manager chest-up at left with the active workflow display filling the right.
clips.lands_on: The same chest-up manager and display composition with all four agents and connected systems visible.
clips.composition_note: Preserve the entire agent-and-resource area; use f/8 instead of the planner's f/11 to remain within the available stop choices while retaining depth.
clips.why: Reveal 4: the strongest workflow evidence earns sustained inspection, so the camera deliberately stays still instead of competing with parallel activation.
clips.camera_sentence: Hold the eye-level chest-up composition as the agents illuminate, keeping the manager at left and the complete agent-and-resource display visible at right.

clips.direction: toward the manager and quotation together
clips.motivation: Emphasize the completed output while retaining the person responsible for approving it.
clips.opens_on: Company B Operations Manager waist-up at left beside the agent-and-system display.
clips.lands_on: The manager chest-up beside the quotation with its Awaiting Approval status still visible.
clips.composition_note: Match setup E's height and angle, advancing only far enough to retain both the face and pending status.
clips.why: Reveal 4: moving closer to the quotation and its human approver together makes the approval boundary more important than automated completion.
clips.camera_sentence: From an eye-level waist-up view, move slowly closer when the quotation appears, settling with the manager chest-up beside the quotation and its pending status.

clips.trigger: The quotation remains pending human approval.
clips.motivation: Make the system's deliberate stopping point unmistakable before returning to the decision-maker.
clips.opens_on: A tight display insert centred on the words Awaiting Approval.
clips.angle_reason: The lens is level with the status at workstation height to present the approval boundary directly and without perspective distortion.
clips.composition_note: Keep the complete status sharply isolated; no other quotation content enters the crop.
clips.why: Tension 2: a quiet, unchanging pending status creates the pause that makes the return to human responsibility land harder.
clips.camera_sentence: Hold a tight, level insert centred on Awaiting Approval, keeping the entire status sharp and the framing unchanged.

clips.direction: straight toward Company B Operations Manager
clips.trigger: The manager delivers the closing distinction between repetitive work and human decisions.
clips.motivation: Make the person, rather than the dashboard, the scene's final source of authority.
clips.opens_on: Company B Operations Manager waist-up on the left third with rightward looking space.
clips.lands_on: A close-up of the manager's face, retaining the visitor's rightward eyeline.
clips.angle_reason: Match setup B's restrained upward angle; the tighter landing now makes the host's decision-making authority explicit.
clips.composition_note: Maintain setup B's left placement as the face grows; this is the scene's largest speaking-face size change.
clips.why: Realisation 5: the largest measured advance follows the quiet status insert and lands the scene's central truth on the human decision-maker.
clips.camera_sentence: From a slightly low waist-up view, move steadily and slowly closer through the closing explanation, settling on the manager's face with looking space to the right.

clips.direction: straight back from the manager and workstation
clips.trigger: The manager's shoulders settle after the explanation.
clips.motivation: Release the concentrated demonstration back into its everyday workplace without transferring emphasis to the software.
clips.opens_on: Company B Operations Manager waist-up at left, with the workstation and back of the display at lower right.
clips.lands_on: Company B Operations Manager framed to mid-thigh beside more of the desk and organised office, with the visitor still outside the right edge.
clips.composition_note: Keep the manager on the left third and limit the widening so the visitor remains beyond the right crop.
clips.why: Transition 2: a modest smooth withdrawal releases the peak into the organised office while leaving the responsible manager as the final emphasis.
clips.camera_sentence: From an eye-level waist-up view, move slowly back as the manager's shoulders settle, ending at mid-thigh with more desk and office around the manager.
